items.title: Harold Dejan Interview, 1960-10-14
items.q: Morett was playing trumpet. ... I was assistant, I was a master of the Navy band and also an Army band.

ctx.x: And then you played in the Navy band? Yeah. Navy band. Yeah.

Well, after the Navy, they was not making a reserve Navy band. I got in the inactive reserve and when the Army was making a band at Spencer, a very good bass player, teaching music in New Iberraighton, I think. Well, he told me, he said, I'm gonna get an Army band here in the band again. He said, with your rating, he said, you'll be way up there. So I said, I think I will. So I got in the Navy, an Army band then, and Army, Melvin C. Bryant, a music teacher at Dillard University, had a charge in the band. Well, I…
Well, you mentioned outside some, who was it that Saeed's brother-in-law or something? Oh, Benny Benoit.
